Meet Emily and Shari

As longtime residents, Emily and Shari understand the concerns of our community because they pay attention and show up. They see the frustration about overdevelopment, the need for sensitivity to the environment, the lack of transparency regarding major projects, and insufficient communication from local officials. Emily and Shari are committed to restoring trust and ensuring that residents have a stronger voice in the decisions that shape our town.

Learn More

On the Issues

  • Put our community first, not developers.
  • Support our first responders by ensuring that all emergency services, including the First Aid Squad, receive the funding and resources they need.
  • Provide careful oversight of the Condurso's tract redevelopment by giving the project the attention it deserves and seeking input from a broad range of qualified community experts and residents.
  • Protect open space by ensuring that open space funds are used for their intended purpose—the preservation and acquisition of open space for future generations.

Latest Updates

From the Campaign Trail

The Full Montville - The Town that Sued Itself - Insider NJ

Montville residents deserve a government that works together, not against itself.

There simply is no way to sugar coat this one. Our Township Committee — the same body that appoints every member of our Zoning Board — took the extraordinary step of suing it’s own Board over its handling of the Diversified project. The lawsuit argued the Zoning Board that our own governing body created and empowered had exceeded its statutory authority.

A Look at Montville

Our campaign has gained state-wide attention as being in serious contention this year.

That was the upbeat assessment of Shari Seffer, one of two Democratic candidates for township committee this year. Seffer and her running mate, Emily Ryzuk, officially kicked off their campaign Sunday evening at the Black Rabbit, a local watering hole.
